sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s
 ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Md Fazle Karim, Adv
 For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ram Priya Sharan Singh, App
For the complainant Mr. Ajit Ranjan Kumar, Adv

======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Justice Smt. Soni Shrivastava
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the complainant learned counsel for the state.
2. Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under sections 498A of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The case is one under section 498A and the petitioner is husband.
The matter has been referred to Mediation Center for amicable settlement but the mediation process failed.

4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the allegation made in the complaint is not correct and as a matter of fact, the mother of petitioner has lodged a complaint against the complainant and her family members, which is Annexure-P- Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57884 of 2024(5) dt.10-07-2025 2 to the said application in which cognizance has also been taken.

Further,
the petitioner has always been ready to keep his wife with full honour and dignity but the same has been refused by OP.No.2.
6. The learned counsel for the O.P.No. 2 however controverts the submission made by the learned counsel for the petitioner.

sentences.text: At this stage, the learned cousnel for the petitioner makes an offer to pay a sum of Rs. 25,00/- per month to the complainant subject to final outcome of any maintenance or collateral proceeding.

8. Considering all the above mentioned facts and circumstances, let the above named petitioner, in the event of his arrest/ surrender within a period of four weeks from today, be released on bail on furnishing bail bonds of Rs 10,000/- (ten thousand)with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned court below where the case is pending/ successor court in Complaint Case No. 109 of 2024 , subject to condition as laid down under section 438(2) of the Cr.PC and subject to the further condition that the petitioner shall co-operate in investigation/ trial.

9. Learned counsel for the O.P.No.2 under instruction, Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.57884 of 2024(5) dt.10-07-2025 submits that she undertakes to provide her bank account details to the petitioner within a period of two weeks from today, if the O.P.No. 2 furnishes the bank account in which the amount can be transferred, and yet the petitioner fails to give the aforesaid amount on two consecutive dates to O.P.No.2, the O.P.No.2 would be at liberty to file cancellation of bail .
(Soni Shrivastava, J) N.K/-
